Ivy: Quick planning thread for regional guardrails + opt-out windows. We need a short, repeatable protocol so Sales can request per-tenant opt-outs and Eng has clear snapshotting for A/B. Proposal: smoke (internal), regional slice (5%/48h), staged ramp (25%/24h), full. Also: take an experiment snapshot before each phase so we can A/B compare downstream metrics.

Max: Agree. Two additions: require billing impact check before phase move (token_cost_ratio) and enforce max 2 concurrent model experiments per tenant. Opt-out API should be auditable.

Hector: Telemetry gates: p95 latency delta, error_rate_5m, queue_depth, token_cost_ratio, golden_match_rate. Gate rule example: (error_rate>0.4% OR p95_delta>20%) => pause + notify. We'll add a p99 tail watch too.

Yuri: For snapshots: capture prompt-set responses + request metadata + model tag. Store snapshot id in rollout metadata. Example flag JSON to annotate snapshot id:
```
{"flag":"regional.guardrails.v1","phase":1,"snapshot_id":"snap-20260401-01"}
```
This helps eval team re-run offline comparisons.

Kelsey: Customer opt-out flow: Sales files opt-out request with tenant_id, region, and desired window. Ops grants per-tenant toggle for that tenant for the rollout correlation id. Require 48h lead time for enterprise opt-ins. Audit log entries required for compliance.

Ivy: Runbook short steps on gate trip:
1) pause rollout job
2) apply per-tenant override if needed (`rbctl flag set --flag regional.guardrails --tenant 111 --pct 0`)
3) validate traffic shift in console
4) post incident when VIP affected
Add: who owns rollback? oncall owns smoke/alpha, eng-platform owns staged/global.

oncall: acknowledged. Will staff for first 72h.

Max: Small SQL for gating dashboard (p95 delta):
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms,95) FILTER (WHERE tag='guardrails') - percentile(latency_ms,95) FILTER (WHERE tag='baseline') FROM requests SINCE 15m
```

Hector: Also: snapshot retention policy = 30 days for A/B replays, then purge unless product requests extension. Kelsey: confirm legal for retention window.

Kelsey: Legal ok with 30d for snapshots, EU opt-outs need explicit DPA attach. Will update docs.

rollout-bot: orchestration queued -> regional.guardrails canary -> smoke window 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z :rocket:

Ivy: Good. I'll update the PRD and add snapshot wiring to the eval harness. Booking shiproom after CI green. :thumbsup:
